description: FIN-01 (val4): complete worksheet AS 109 trace of the endpoint-saturation search BETA.INV(1E-200,0.5,0.5) / F.INV(1E-200,1,1), public kernels, val3-fin-01 trace formulas unchanged (columns O, P, S, T dropped), 640 trial rows (each Newton step is expected to take one rejected trial and one one-third retry, about 303 steps). Seed sheet computes AS 109's small-shape first estimate in cells and replaces an end estimate by 1E-6. Hypothesis: Seed!B13 = Seed!B11 bit for bit and stop code 3 (squared-step floor 1E-300). Cached: BETA.INV(1E-200,0.5,0.5) = 2.7055792171147168E-151 (probes/t4974-beta-f-inv-endpoint-saturation A4), F.INV(1E-200,1,1) = 2.705579217114786E-151 (gen-m9/35e8168aae2b00f8 A64). The trace gives Excel's BETA.DIST cdf and density at shape 1/2 on every iterate from 1E-6 down to 2.7E-151, which no filled probe has. 640 is a probe budget, not an Excel cap; INCOMPLETE is inconclusive. Precision!B2:B4 must retain 0.9999999999999998, 1, 1.0000000000000002; C2:C4 must be -1,0,1. Predictions are hypotheses, NOT expected/oracle values. Protocol: docs/research/probe-request-val4-fin.md.
